description: This source file defines the SparkConnectPluginRegistry object, which manages registration, instantiation, and configuration of various plugins (relation, expression, command, ML backend) for Spark Connect. It includes methods for loading plugins from configuration, creating plugin instances, and maintaining plugin caches.

classes.name: SparkConnectPluginRegistry
classes.description: Singleton object managing registration, instantiation, and configuration of Spark Connect plugins, including relation, expression, command, and ML backend plugins.

methods.name: relationRegistry
methods.description: Returns the cached list of relation plugins, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: expressionRegistry
methods.description: Returns the cached list of expression plugins, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: commandRegistry
methods.description: Returns the cached list of command plugins, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: mlBackendRegistry
methods.description: Loads ML backend plugins based on the provided SQLConf.

methods.name: withInitialize
methods.description: Ensures plugin caches are loaded once in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: loadRelationPlugins
methods.description: Loads relation plugins from chain and configuration.

methods.name: loadExpressionPlugins
methods.description: Loads expression plugins from chain and configuration.

methods.name: loadCommandPlugins
methods.description: Loads command plugins from chain and configuration.

methods.name: loadMlBackendPlugins
methods.description: Loads ML backend plugins from configuration.

methods.name: createConfiguredPlugins
methods.description: Creates plugin instances from configuration class names.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Instantiates a plugin class using its default constructor, with error handling.

methods.name: relation
methods.description: Returns a callable that instantiates a RelationPlugin of the specified class.

methods.name: expression
methods.description: Returns a callable that instantiates an ExpressionPlugin of the specified class.

methods.name: command
methods.description: Returns a callable that instantiates a CommandPlugin of the specified class.
